segments.subtask: The robot arm moves towards the left basket, positioning itself to pick up an item.
The robot arm grasps an item from the left basket using the left gripper.
The robot arm moves the grasped item towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the item into the right basket using the right gripper.
The robot arm returns to the left basket to pick up another item.
The robot arm grasps a non-food item from the left basket using the left gripper.
The robot arm moves the non-food item towards the left basket.
